messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — we need to pick next quarter priorities for inference UX + cost controls. two big asks: customer A wants per-route throttles; several teams want batching presets
Sanjay (Eng): can we prioritize by RICE? have rough numbers for both
Maya (PM): yes, I sketched a quick RICE for both. sharing below
Maya (PM): Feature A (per-route throttles): Reach=6 Impact=7 Confidence=0.8 Effort=5 -> score ~= (6*7*0.8)/5 = 6.72
Maya (PM): Feature B (batching presets): Reach=8 Impact=6 Confidence=0.6 Effort=6 -> score ~= (8*6*0.6)/6 = 4.8
Alex (TPM): math looks fine, but RICE hides sequencing/deps. throttles depends on infra sharding work (Lia)
Lia (Infra): correct — per-route throttles require routing table changes + rollout gate. estimated 2 wks infra spike + 1 wk rollback-safe integration
Sanjay (Eng): if infra needs 3w, eng effort grows. RICE effort number should be bumped
Maya (PM): good call. update effort for Feature A -> 8. recalc: (6*7*0.8)/8 = 4.2
Olivia (Support): customer A is hitting throttling pain daily. they said SLA risk if not addressed by EOW in 6 weeks
Dan (ML): batching presets could reduce token cost 12% for chat-heavy workloads. downstream models benefit but no immediate SLA risk
Alex (TPM): tradeoff: short-term customer SLA vs medium-term platform cost savings. do we treat SLA as higher impact multiplier?
Maya (PM): leaning to prioritize per-route throttles for Q2 minimum viable (thin scope) and defer full-featured presets to Q3. propose MVP: basic per-route qps + fallback policy
Sanjay (Eng): MVP reduces infra effort to ~4 (no fancy rollout gates). re-run RICE MVP: Reach=6 Impact=7 Conf=0.7 Effort=4 -> score = (6*7*0.7)/4 = 7.35
Lia (Infra): can support 2-week spike next sprint if PM commits to scoped acceptance criteria and test plan
Olivia (Support): that works for customer A, they can tolerate an incremental rollout. we'll coordinate beta
Dan (ML): for batching presets, can we start a small experiment in parallel (one engineer, part-time) to validate the 12% claim? low cost, low risk
Maya (PM): yes — propose 0.2 FTE for two sprints on evals and a config prototype. keeps momentum without delaying throttles
Alex (TPM): dependencies checklist: infra routing + canary plan (Lia), API surface minimal (Sanjay), docs + support runbook (Olivia). I'll own sequencing and tracker
Maya (PM): decision: greenlight throttles-MVP for Q2; allocate 0.2 FTE to batching experiments; owner assignments as above. any objections?
Sanjay (Eng): +1
Lia (Infra): +1
Olivia (Support): +1 (will draft runbook)
Dan (ML): +1 for experiment
product-bot: created ticket PROD-1427 for "per-route throttles MVP" and linked to this thread
Maya (PM): I'll update the roadmap board and add acceptance criteria: "Q2 launch: per-route qps, simple fallback, beta with Customer A, rollback < 30m"
Alex (TPM): will post sequencing timeline in the tracker by EOD. thanks all :thumbsup
